english_definition: If there is a lack of something, there is not enough of it.
example_sentence: His only problem is a lack of money.

english_definition: To perform is to do something in front of people who watch.
example_sentence: He will perform a song for the class.

english_definition: Pressure is what you apply to make someone do something.
example_sentence: They put pressure on him to change his mind.

english_definition: If something will probably happen, it is likely to happen.
example_sentence: You will probably get a good grade if you study for the test.

english_definition: If something is public, it is meant for everyone to use.
example_sentence: I went to the public park to play with my friends.

english_definition: Smart means intelligent.
example_sentence: Mary is a smart student.

english_definition: To strike people or things is to hit them.
example_sentence: She struck the other girl in the face.

english_definition: To support something is to like it and help it be successful.
example_sentence: Everyone at work supports the new plan.

english_definition: A term is a word for something.
example_sentence: I often use the term "oops" when I make a mistake.

english_definition: To unite is to get together to do something.
example_sentence: If we unite, we can finish our project faster.

english_definition: To associate means to connect something with a person or thing.
example_sentence: Most people associate birthday parties with having fun.

english_definition: The environment is the place where people work or live.
example_sentence: Keeping our environment clean is important to our health.

english_definition: A factory is a building where things are made or put together.
example_sentence: We have only one factory in our town.

english_definition: A feature is an important part of something.
example_sentence: The cell phone has many features.

english_definition: An instance is an example of something.
example_sentence: I have never experienced an instance of hate. Have you?

english_definition: To involve means to include as an active participant.
example_sentence: The whole family was involved in playing the game.

english_definition: Medicine is something you take to feel better or treat an illness.
example_sentence: The doctor gave me medicine for my cold.

english_definition: A mix is different things put together.
example_sentence: The green mix we made in science class spilled onto the table.

english_definition: To organize is to plan or get ready for an event.
example_sentence: Make a list to help you organize the things you need.

english_definition: A period is an amount of time when something happens.
example_sentence: In one period in Europe, there were many knights.

english_definition: If people populate an area, they live there.
example_sentence: Billions of people populate the Earth.

english_definition: To produce something is to make or grow it.
example_sentence: This tree produces apples every year.

english_definition: A range is a number or a set of similar things.
example_sentence: I saw a range of cars to choose from.

english_definition: To recognize something is to know it because you have seen it before.
example_sentence: I recognized an old friend from many years ago.

english_definition: If something is regular, it happens often and in equal amounts of time.
example_sentence: Our regular lunch time is around noon.

english_definition: A sign is an indication giving information, directions, a warning, etc.
example_sentence: The sign indicated that today would be a bad day.

english_definition: A tip is a pointed end of something.
example_sentence: The tip of his pen was very sharp.

english_definition: A tradition is something people have been doing for a long time.
example_sentence: Marriage is a tradition all over the world.

english_definition: Trash is waste material or unwanted or worthless things.
example_sentence: Please take out the trash; it smells bad.

english_definition: If something is wide, it is large from side to side.
example_sentence: The door was as wide as my arms.

english_definition: Advice is an opinion about what to do.
example_sentence: I don't know how to study for my exams. Can you give me some advice?

english_definition: Along means down the length of a road, river, etc.
example_sentence: Walk along this tunnel for ten minutes, and you'll see a door on the left.

english_definition: Attention is the notice, thought, or consideration of someone.
example_sentence: His work got the attention of two of his co-workers.

english_definition: To attract means to make a person or thing come closer or be interested.
example_sentence: The magnet attracted the metal.

english_definition: To climb means to use your hands and feet to go up something.
example_sentence: The girls climbed to the top of the mountain.

english_definition: To drop is to fall or allow something to fall.
example_sentence: A small amount of water dropped from the bottle.

english_definition: If something is final, it is the last part.
example_sentence: In the final part of the film, the man and the woman got married.

english_definition: Further means at or from a greater distance or time.
example_sentence: The escalator is further than I thought.

english_definition: To imply something is to suggest it without saying it.
example_sentence: The man implied that he wanted the job, but he didn't say so.

english_definition: To maintain means to make something stay the same.
example_sentence: The balls maintain constant movement.

english_definition: You use neither to connect two negative possibilities.
example_sentence: Neither the path on the left nor the path on the right will lead us home.

english_definition: Otherwise means in another way if you don't do this.
example_sentence: It's good to stay active; otherwise, you'll gain weight.

english_definition: If something is physical, it is related to your body and not your mind.
example_sentence: Biking is good for your physical health.

english_definition: To prove something is to show that it is true.
example_sentence: My teacher proved the answer on the board.

english_definition: To react is to respond by acting in a certain way.
example_sentence: James reacted badly to the news.

english_definition: To ride something is to travel on it. You can ride an animal, a bike, etc.
example_sentence: I will ride a roller coaster for the first time today.

english_definition: If something is situated somewhere, it is in that place.
example_sentence: The whiteboard is situated between the two men.

english_definition: Society is a group of people who interact and share a culture.
example_sentence: Society expects people to be good and honest.

english_definition: A standard is what people consider normal or good.
example_sentence: This older model TV is below our store's standards.

english_definition: To suggest something means to give an idea or plan about it.
example_sentence: He suggested that we go to see his boss.

english_definition: Actually means in fact or really.
example_sentence: My dad looks a little mean, but actually he's very kind.

english_definition: Bite is the act of using your teeth to cut and tear into something.
example_sentence: The boy took a big bite of his hamburger.

english_definition: The coast is the land by an ocean.
example_sentence: I stayed on the southern coast of Australia.

english_definition: A deal is an agreement that you have with another person.
example_sentence: I made a deal with the other company to give us some money.

english_definition: The desert is an area of land without many plants or water.
example_sentence: Not many plants grow in the desert.

english_definition: If something is effective, it works well.
example_sentence: Swimming is an effective way to stay healthy.

english_definition: To examine something is to look at it carefully.
example_sentence: The doctor examined my eyes today.

english_definition: If something is false, it is not correct.
example_sentence: If you think the answer is false, press the red button.

english_definition: When you figure something out, you come to understand it and find an answer.
example_sentence: I couldn't figure out what he wanted me to do.

english_definition: A gift is something you give someone.
example_sentence: Dave received many gifts for Christmas.

english_definition: Hunger is the feeling that you get when you need to eat.
example_sentence: After playing all day long, he was filled with hunger.

english_definition: To imagine something is to think of it in your mind.
example_sentence: Sally imagined herself winning lots of money.

english_definition: A journey is a long trip.
example_sentence: I went on a journey across the country with my parents.

english_definition: A puzzle is something that is hard to understand.
example_sentence: The question was a puzzle to him.

english_definition: Quite means that something is a certain way completely or very much.
example_sentence: I think typing on a keyboard is quite easy.

english_definition: Rather is used when you want to do one thing but not the other.
example_sentence: I would rather have the red one than the blue one.

english_definition: If something is specific, it is precise or exact.
example_sentence: Please choose a specific place on the map.

english_definition: A spider is a small creature with eight legs.
example_sentence: Some adults have a fear of little creatures such as spiders.

english_definition: A tour is a short trip in which you see many sights.
example_sentence: I took a tour of Asia and Europe.

english_definition: A trip is a journey to a certain place.
example_sentence: Ken took a trip to the city yesterday.

english_definition: A band is a group of people who play music.
example_sentence: My brother is in a rock band.

english_definition: Barely means by the smallest amount, almost not.
example_sentence: I barely had enough money to pay for my bus ticket.

english_definition: If something is boring, it is not fun.
example_sentence: I think the internet is boring.

english_definition: To cancel means to decide that an event or a request will not happen.
example_sentence: She canceled the rest of her plans because of the rain.

english_definition: A driveway is a short private road that leads to a person's home.
example_sentence: The long driveway led us to their new house.

english_definition: Garbage is waste material like unwanted or spoiled food, bottles, paper, etc.
example_sentence: The boy cleaned up the garbage around his house.

english_definition: An instrument is something designed to do a certain task like play music.
example_sentence: My favorite musical instrument is the piano.

english_definition: A list is a record of information printed with an item on each line.
example_sentence: My mom makes a list of groceries to buy.

english_definition: Magic is the power to do impossible things.
example_sentence: The magician used magic to pull a rabbit out of his hat.

english_definition: A message is a set of words that you send to someone.
example_sentence: I left a message for you in the envelope.

english_definition: To notice something is to see it for the first time.
example_sentence: Did you notice the view?

english_definition: To own something means to have it. That thing belongs to you.
example_sentence: My grandfather owns that house.

english_definition: To predict something is to say that it will happen.
example_sentence: She predicted that I would get married next year.

english_definition: A professor is a person who teaches in college.
example_sentence: Mike's science professor knows a lot about physics.

english_definition: To rush is to go somewhere or do something very quickly.
example_sentence: Nancy rushed to finish her homework.

english_definition: A schedule is a plan that tells you when to do things.
example_sentence: What is your class schedule for today?

english_definition: To share something is to give some of it to another person.
example_sentence: Jimmy shared his apple with me.

english_definition: A stage is a place where actors or musicians act or sing.
example_sentence: A large screen was on the stage.

english_definition: A storm is very bad weather. There is a lot of rain or snow.
example_sentence: Did that storm wake you up last night?

english_definition: You use within to say that something is inside another thing.
example_sentence: Within the box, there was a pizza.

english_definition: A burden is a serious or difficult responsibility.
example_sentence: Children who do not behave are a burden to their parents.

english_definition: To compromise is to agree to something that is not exactly what you want.
example_sentence: We both compromised about the game we decided to play.

english_definition: To craft something is to make it using skill.
example_sentence: She crafted the bookcase out of solid pine wood and then painted it.

english_definition: When you dive into water, you go down head first into the water.
example_sentence: I like sky-diving from an airplane.

english_definition: When people or things are fragile, they are not strong and can be damaged easily.
example_sentence: The fragile glassware was carefully packed into boxes.

english_definition: If you cut something into two parts that are the same size, you cut it half.
example_sentence: The machine can divide the book in half.

english_definition: Innocence is a lack of experience of difficult or complex things in life.
example_sentence: Everyone who met her found her innocence to be charming.

english_definition: When you lead something, you go first and it follows you.
example_sentence: I will lead you to the right place.

english_definition: When you have a meeting, you are with other people.
example_sentence: We have lots of meetings at our school to plan what to do.

english_definition: To merge two things is to combine them into one whole thing.
example_sentence: The storm clouds merged into one large menacing cloud that filled the sky.

english_definition: When something is moderate, it is not too big or too small in size or amount.
example_sentence: It takes a moderate amount of patience to be around small children all day.

english_definition: To overwhelm is to exist in such a large amount that someone cannot deal with it.
example_sentence: The amount of homework her teacher assigned has overwhelmed her.

english_definition: When you make a payment, you give someone some money for what you get.
example_sentence: I made the last payment on my car yesterday. Now I am really the owner.

english_definition: A perception of a situation is a way of thinking about it or understanding it.
example_sentence: Since he couldn't see, his perception of life was much different than mine.

english_definition: When you settle something, you reach an agreement.
example_sentence: We settled the argument by looking up the answer on the web.

english_definition: A shiver is a shaking movement the body makes when someone is cold or scared.
example_sentence: I got shivers on my way home because it was so cold.

english_definition: When someone is sociable, they are friendly.
example_sentence: Many of my good friends are sociable, but I am shy.

english_definition: When you speed, you go very fast.
example_sentence: Speeding is the cause of most car accidents.

english_definition: When someone is talkative, he or she talks a lot.
example_sentence: My aunt is very talkative whenever she is on the phone.

english_definition: When something is usual, it is what we expect.
example_sentence: It was just the usual people who came.

english_definition: If something is above, it is at a higher level than something else.
example_sentence: He straightened the sign that was above the crowd.

english_definition: If something is ahead of something else, it is in front of it.
example_sentence: The blue car drove on ahead of us.

english_definition: An amount is how much there is of something.
example_sentence: Can I use my card to pay for the entire amount?

english_definition: A belief is a strong feeling that something is correct or true.
example_sentence: A preacher or priest should have a strong belief in God.

english_definition: The center of something is the middle of it.
example_sentence: The center of a dart board is the most important spot.

english_definition: If something is common, it happens often or there is much of it.
example_sentence: It is common for snow to fall in the winter.

english_definition: To cost is to require payment.
example_sentence: These designer shoes cost more than the regular ones.

english_definition: To demonstrate something is to show how it is done.
example_sentence: She demonstrated her plan to her co-workers.

english_definition: Different describes someone or something that is not the same as others.
example_sentence: Each of my sisters has a different hair style.

english_definition: Evidence is a fact or thing that you use to prove something.
example_sentence: He used the pictures as evidence that UFOs are real.

english_definition: Honesty means the quality of being truthful or honest.
example_sentence: A courtroom should be a place of honesty.

english_definition: An idiom is a phrase with a meaning different from its words.
example_sentence: The idiom "when pigs fly" means that something will never happen.

english_definition: If something is independent, it is not controlled by something else.
example_sentence: She chose to live an independent life in the country.

english_definition: Inside means the inner part, space or side of something.
example_sentence: The inside of the box was empty.

english_definition: A jail is a place to keep bad people.
example_sentence: He was sent to jail for taking other people's cars.

english_definition: A master is a person who is very good at something.
example_sentence: My brother is a master of taekwondo.

english_definition: A memory is something you remember.
example_sentence: The memory of my first time in the city will always be the best.

english_definition: A pocket is a part of your clothing where you can keep things.
example_sentence: She always had her hands in her pockets.

english_definition: If something is proper, it is right.
example_sentence: It is not proper to throw your garbage on the road.

english_definition: If something is for sale, you can buy it.
example_sentence: Everything for sale here is the same price.

english_definition: Because introduces a reason for something.
example_sentence: We need to study because we have a test tomorrow.

english_definition: East is the direction the sun rises from.
example_sentence: My window looks to the east, so I can watch the sunrise every morning.

english_definition: Expensive things cost a lot of money.
example_sentence: My friend drives an expensive sports car.

english_definition: A flower is the colored part of a plant.
example_sentence: She gave pink flowers to her grandmother.

english_definition: A garden is an area where people grow plants.
example_sentence: The garden is very bright and colorful in the spring.

english_definition: A holiday is a special day of celebration.
example_sentence: Monday was a holiday, so there was no school or work.

english_definition: Many shows that there is a large number of something.
example_sentence: There are many people on the street.

english_definition: A million is another way to write the number 1,000,000.
example_sentence: Almost 19 million people live in Delhi, India.

english_definition: A mountain is a very high hill.
example_sentence: Mount Everest is the highest mountain in the world.

english_definition: A place is a space or area.
example_sentence: A library is a place where people can read books.

english_definition: A popular thing is liked by many people.
example_sentence: These people are listening to a popular man speak.

english_definition: To ski is to glide on long pieces of wood or metal over snow.
example_sentence: The man likes to ski and goes every weekend.

english_definition: Such means "like this".
example_sentence: I have never seen such a beautiful sunset before.

english_definition: Total shows that everyone or everything has been counted.
example_sentence: The total cost of the items she bought was $52.

english_definition: A tower is a tall, narrow building.
example_sentence: This is a very famous tower in Italy.

english_definition: A town is a place where people live and work, and is smaller than a city.
example_sentence: I come from a small town, and everyone there knows each other.

english_definition: A train is a group of railway cars connected together.
example_sentence: The train is very fast, so we can get home in one hour.

english_definition: To walk is to move forward using legs, but it is slower than running.
example_sentence: The children walk to school in the morning.

english_definition: To watch is to look at someone or something for a period of time.
example_sentence: My friend came over to watch a movie with me.

english_definition: The world is the Earth and all the people and things in it.
example_sentence: What are the names of the five oceans of the world?

english_definition: Anxious means feeling worried or nervous.
example_sentence: She was anxious about not making her appointment on time.

english_definition: An awful thing is very bad.
example_sentence: Her performance last night was awful.

english_definition: To consist of certain is to be made of parts or things them.
example_sentence: Today's choices for lunch consisted of pizza, hamburgers, and hot dogs.

english_definition: To desire is to want something.
example_sentence: My sister desires a big house and lots of money.

english_definition: Eager shows excitement about something.
example_sentence: The man was eager to talk about the good news.

english_definition: A household is all the people who live in one house.
example_sentence: Our household is made up of my father, my mother, and me.

english_definition: An intent is a plan to do something.
example_sentence: Her intent is to visit Italy next summer.

english_definition: A landscape is how an area of land looks.
example_sentence: The landscape of the country is very green.

english_definition: To lift something is to move it higher.
example_sentence: The man tried to lift the box.

english_definition: To load is to put objects into something.
example_sentence: The man loaded the boxes into a truck.

english_definition: A lung is a part of the body that fills with air when breathing.
example_sentence: Having strong lungs is necessary for a healthy life.

english_definition: A motion is a movement that someone makes.
example_sentence: The police officer made a motion with his hand.

english_definition: The pace of something is the speed at which it happens.
example_sentence: I ran the race at a slower pace than my friend.

english_definition: Polite shows a thoughtful and kind behavior.
example_sentence: The boy was very polite; he behaved very thoughtfully.

english_definition: To possess something is to have it or own it.
example_sentence: My uncle possesses three sheep, a chicken, a cow, and a dog.

english_definition: Rapidly means happening very fast.
example_sentence: The train moved rapidly on the tracks.

english_definition: To remark is to say something.
example_sentence: The teacher remarked on how quickly the students were learning.

english_definition: To seek is to look for something.
example_sentence: If I have a problem, I seek my sister's advice.

english_definition: To shine is to make a bright light.
example_sentence: The candles are shining in the dark room.

english_definition: To spill is to accidentally make something fall out of its container.
example_sentence: I spilled the coffee on the table.

english_definition: An arrow is a thin, straight stick shot from a bow.
example_sentence: The arrow flew through the air and hit the target.

english_definition: A battle is a fight between two armies during a war.
example_sentence: The battle lasted for many days.

english_definition: A bow is a weapon made of curved wood and string that shoots arrows.
example_sentence: He went hunting with a bow and arrow.

english_definition: A brave person is not afraid to face pain or danger.
example_sentence: The brave firefighter saved the girl from the burning building.

english_definition: A chief is the leader of a group of people.
example_sentence: The chief led the people through the mountains.

english_definition: A disadvantage is a situation that makes it hard to do something.
example_sentence: Mike had a disadvantage in the race since he hurt his knee.

english_definition: An enemy is a country that is fighting another country during a war.
example_sentence: The enemy prepared to attack the kingdom.

english_definition: An entrance is a place where someone can enter an area.
example_sentence: The gate was locked, so Bill had to find a different entrance.

english_definition: Hardly shows that something happens in a very small way.
example_sentence: I hardly saw the concert since I had to leave early.

english_definition: To intend to do something means to plan to do it.
example_sentence: I intend to finish college in three years.

english_definition: Laughter is the sound produced by laughing about something funny.
example_sentence: Susan's joke made her classmates burst into laughter.

english_definition: A log is a thick piece of wood that is cut from a tree.
example_sentence: The fire was too small, so we added another log to it.

english_definition: The military is the armed forces of a country.
example_sentence: I joined the military after I finished high school.

english_definition: To obey means to follow what a law or a person says to do.
example_sentence: My little sister did not obey my mother. Now, she is in trouble.

english_definition: To secure something means to get it after a lot of effort.
example_sentence: I was able to secure a good grade on my test after weeks of studying.

english_definition: Steady shows that someone or something does not change much.
example_sentence: The problem was hard, but she remained steady and solved it.

english_definition: To trust is to believe that someone is honest and will do what is right.
example_sentence: I trust my friends; they don't tell my secrets to other people.

english_definition: When we twist something we turn it around and around.
example_sentence: She twisted the spaghetti around her fork.

english_definition: Unless means if not or except when.
example_sentence: Unless you clean your room, you cannot play with your friends.

english_definition: A weapon is an object used to hurt people.
example_sentence: Swords have been used as weapons for thousands of years.

english_definition: The chest is the front part of a body between the neck and stomach.
example_sentence: The water in the lake was as high as my chest.

english_definition: Confidence is a feeling of certainty or ability.
example_sentence: I have confidence that I did well on the test.

english_definition: A consequence is a result of a choice or action.
example_sentence: As a consequence of missing my bus, I had to find another way to work.

english_definition: A disaster is a really bad thing that happens.
example_sentence: When the car crashed, it was a disaster.

english_definition: To disturb someone means to upset that person.
example_sentence: The loud noise disturbed me while I was working.

english_definition: To estimate something means to make a guess about it.
example_sentence: The boy estimated that he was one meter tall.

english_definition: To honor is to show respect for someone or something.
example_sentence: Each year we honor those who died fighting for their country.

english_definition: To impress someone means to make that person proud or amazed.
example_sentence: He was able to impress the girls with his new dance.

english_definition: A narrow object or space is thin, not wide.
example_sentence: The bridge is too narrow for a car to drive across it.

english_definition: Pale means that a color or thing is not bright.
example_sentence: The girl's skin was very pale.

english_definition: A rough thing is not even or smooth.
example_sentence: The rough ground hurt my feet.

english_definition: To satisfy someone means to make that person happy.
example_sentence: It will satisfy my teacher if I finish all my homework.

english_definition: To scream means to make a loud noise with your mouth.
example_sentence: The girl saw a spider and screamed.

english_definition: A sensitive person or thing is easily hurt.
example_sentence: My teeth are sensitive to cold things.

english_definition: Shade is a dark area that something makes when it blocks the sun.
example_sentence: It was hot outside, so the boy sat in the shade of a tree.

english_definition: Strength is the ability to do hard work or exercise.
example_sentence: Eating good food builds up your strength.

english_definition: To supplement something is to add something else to it in a good way.
example_sentence: He supplements his diet with fresh fruits.

english_definition: Terror is a feeling of very strong fear.
example_sentence: I felt a sense of terror when the tiger chased me.

english_definition: A threat is something bad that might happen.
example_sentence: Due to the dark clouds, there was a threat of a bad storm.

english_definition: A victim is a person who is hurt by a bad action.
example_sentence: I was a victim of a robbery.

english_definition: An ancestor is a family member from the past.
example_sentence: My ancestors came from Germany.

english_definition: An angle is the direction from which something is looked at.
example_sentence: The giraffe turned its head to see from another angle.

english_definition: A boot is a heavy shoe that goes up above a person's ankle.
example_sentence: He wore boots so that his feet wouldn't get wet.

english_definition: A border is the edge of an area.
example_sentence: The postcard had a pretty green border of pine needles.

english_definition: To congratulate someone is to tell them that you are happy for them.
example_sentence: Bill and Angela congratulated each other on a job well done.

english_definition: A frame is a border for a picture or mirror.
example_sentence: I have to get a frame for my friend's picture.

english_definition: Heaven is the place that some believe people go to after they die.
example_sentence: When I die, I hope that I go to heaven.

english_definition: An incredible thing is so amazing that it is hard to believe.
example_sentence: I have an incredible story to tell you about my vacation.

english_definition: A legend is a story from the past.
example_sentence: There is a well-known legend about a king and his queen.

english_definition: To praise is to show that you like someone or something.
example_sentence: The coach praised the athletes after a good practice.

english_definition: To proceed is to go somewhere or to continue doing something.
example_sentence: My son and I proceeded to the beach so we could go fishing.

english_definition: A pure thing is very clear and beautiful.
example_sentence: The rose was pure. It had no dirt or imperfections.

english_definition: A relative is a family member.
example_sentence: My relatives came by to see the new baby.

english_definition: A senior person is older or more experienced.
example_sentence: Because he got his job first, Bob is the senior chef.

english_definition: A silent person or thing makes no sound.
example_sentence: Since no one was home, the house was silent.

english_definition: To sink into something is to slowly fall into it.
example_sentence: The boat had a hole in it, and it sank into the ocean.

english_definition: A superior person or thing is better than another.
example_sentence: I think cooking outdoors is superior to cooking indoors.

english_definition: To surround something is to close in on it from all sides.
example_sentence: We surrounded the suspect on all four sides.

english_definition: A thick thing is wide and solid.
example_sentence: The fog was so thick that I couldn't see through it.

english_definition: To wrap is to cover something on all sides.
example_sentence: I wrapped his gift and put a bow on it.

english_definition: To magnify something means to make it look bigger than it really is.

english_definition: A minor problem is a very small and unimportant problem.

english_definition: If something is negligible, it is extremely small and not important.

english_definition: Paralysis is the loss of the ability to move all or part of your body.

english_definition: A pest is an animal or insect that hurts plants or food.
example_sentence: Many farmers put up scarecrows to keep pests off their corn.

english_definition: To prevail means to be accepted or very common.

english_definition: When you are in pursuit of something, you are chasing it.

english_definition: To rupture means to tear or burst open.

english_definition: To stun someone means to make them unable to speak due to surprise or shock.

english_definition: To authorize something means to give permission for it.
example_sentence: The mayor authorized the construction of a new statue in the park.

english_definition: A civilian is someone who is not in the military.
example_sentence: It was Todd's job to keep civilians from entering the army facility.

english_definition: A commodity is something that can be bought or sold.
example_sentence: Fran's uncle made most of his money trading commodities.

english_definition: When we communicate with others, we talk or write to them.

english_definition: A conquest is an event by which one country takes over another country.

english_definition: To disclose something means to tell it to someone else.

english_definition: The dynamics of a situation are the way that parts of it affect each other.

english_definition: To enroll in something is to put one's name on a list as a member of a group.

english_definition: When someone is envious, they want something that another person has.

english_definition: When something is festive, it is happy and related to a party or celebration.

english_definition: When we indicate something, we show or point out our thoughts or plans.

english_definition: Lentils are very small beans that people cook and eat.

english_definition: To marshal a group means to assemble them in order.

english_definition: Morale is the amount of hope that people have during a difficult situation.

english_definition: Your mood is the way you are feeling.
example_sentence: My boss is in a really bad mood today.

english_definition: A prophecy is a prediction about what will happen in the future.
example_sentence: Some people believe that prophecies are actually true.

english_definition: A senate is a part of the government in some countries.

english_definition: Unrest is a state of anger about something among the people in a place.

english_definition: To certify something means to confirm that its results are true.
example_sentence: The photograph on her passport certified that she was indeed Jolene Sawyer.

english_definition: The parts of a coherent plan fit well together.

english_definition: To collaborate means to work together on something.

english_definition: To compile things means to collect a variety of them into a group.
example_sentence: She compiled a list of people who she wanted to attend her birthday party.

english_definition: To curb something means to prevent it from happening or increasing.
example_sentence: She curbed her anger by listening to a relaxing song.

english_definition: To diagnose someone means to identify the medical condition they have.

english_definition: To enact something means to make it into a law.

english_definition: A federation is a group of states or businesses working for a common cause.

english_definition: If something is gross, then it is disgusting.

english_definition: If something is humane, then it is good and kind.

english_definition: If someone is needy, they are very poor.

english_definition: To render something means to make it become something else.

english_definition: Smallpox is a disease that causes tiny bumps on the skin and high fevers.

english_definition: To transform something is to change it in a very significant way.

english_definition: When you put an emphasis on prevention, you give special attention to prevention.

english_definition: A hazard is something that could be dangerous to a person's health or safety.

english_definition: Intestines are tubes through which food passes after it leaves the stomach.

english_definition: The provision of something is the act of giving it to people in need or want.

english_definition: To replenish something means to make it full or complete again.

english_definition: When a car reverses, it goes backwards.

english_definition: When something is sterile, it is completely clean and free from germs.

english_definition: To upgrade something means to improve it or make it more efficient.

english_definition: When something is viable, it is capable of doing what it is intended to do.

english_definition: An airway is the passage by which air reaches a person's lungs.

english_definition: The Almighty is a name for a god in a religion.
example_sentence: Before eating, they thanked the Almighty for their food.

english_definition: An advent is the arrival or beginning of an important person, thing, or event.

english_definition: A cycle is a series of events that go in a circle from the end back to the beginning again.

english_definition: If something is definitive, then it is the most official.

english_definition: To equate one thing with another is to compare them and consider them very similar.

english_definition: To found something on an idea or principal is to base it on that idea.

english_definition: To inhale means to take air or a smell into the lungs.

english_definition: A reflex is an unconscious action in which a body part responds to an event.
example_sentence: There was a reflex when the doctor hit his knee with a rubber hammer.

english_definition: A seizure is a sudden condition in which the body loses control and shakes.

english_definition: A session is a meeting at a regular time in order to discuss and solve an issue.

english_definition: A utensil is a common tool or container.
example_sentence: It seemed that a fork was the wrong utensil for trying to eat the soup.

english_definition: To allocate something means to put it aside for a certain purpose or person.

english_definition: When food is appetizing, it looks and smells very good.

english_definition: When you assign work, you give that work to particular people.

english_definition: A cavity is a hole or space in something.

english_definition: If something moves clockwise, it moves in a circle in the same direction as a clock.

english_definition: When circles or rings are concentric, they have the same center.

english_definition: Courtesy is the excellence of manners or social conduct.

english_definition: When food is crisp, it is hard or has a hard surface in a way that is pleasant.

english_definition: Discord is disagreement or fighting.

english_definition: An interchange of ideas between people is a discussion of each person's idea.

english_definition: When something is multicultural, it relates to many different cultures.

english_definition: An omission is something that has been left out or not done.

english_definition: When something is wavy, it is not straight but has a series of curves.

english_definition: An acrobat is a person who entertains people by doing amazing physical things.

english_definition: Advocacy is the act of supporting or recommending something.

english_definition: If someone is industrious, they work hard.

english_definition: When someone is inventive, they are good at creating new things.

english_definition: To rehearse means to practice and prepare for a performance in front of people.

english_definition: A resourceful person is clever at using what resources they have.

english_definition: To scorn someone means to behave without respect toward them.

english_definition: If something is sensory, it is related to the senses.

english_definition: A statute is a law that is official and has been written down.

english_definition: Technical skill requires good control of technique.
example_sentence: Her technical skill was perfect.

english_definition: A veteran is someone who has a lot of experience doing something.

english_definition: A villain is an evil person who breaks the law or hurts others.

english_definition: A vine is a plant that has long, twisting stems and climbs upward.

english_definition: An aroma is a scent or smell.
example_sentence: I love the aroma of coffee in the morning.

english_definition: A beverage is a drink.

english_definition: A cluster of things is a small group of them placed close together.
example_sentence: She held a large cluster of grapes in her hand.

english_definition: To combine is to join together to make a single thing or group.
example_sentence: Mina combined peanut butter and jelly to make a sandwich.

english_definition: When a liquid is condensed, it is made thicker.

english_definition: When something is contemporary, it is related to the present time.

english_definition: To cultivate plants is to care for them and help them grow.

english_definition: When something is divine, it is related to gods.

english_definition: When it is humid, there is a lot of water in the air.

english_definition: An odor is a very distinct smell.
example_sentence: He knew there was a leak when he noticed the strong odor of natural gas.

english_definition: The palate is the top part of the mouth.

english_definition: Paradise is the place or condition of happiness where things are perfect.
example_sentence: My vacation in Hawaii was like being in paradise.

english_definition: A plantation is a big farm that only grows certain kinds of crops.
example_sentence: In the 1800s, there were many cotton plantations in the southern US.

english_definition: A rate is the speed at which something happens.

english_definition: When something is soothing, it makes you calm or relaxed.

english_definition: When something is subtle, it is not easy to see or notice.

english_definition: The texture of something is the way its surface looks and feels.

english_definition: When something is toxic, it is poisonous and very dangerous.

english_definition: To vary means to be different from another thing in size or amount.

english_definition: An admiral is someone who controls many military ships.

english_definition: An arc is a curved shape.

english_definition: Your character is your personality.

english_definition: Your conscience is your inner sense of what is right and wrong.

english_definition: If you escape from a place, you succeed in getting away from it.

english_definition: If something is fiery, it is burning strongly.

english_definition: Flesh is the muscle and fat on your body.

english_definition: A grapefruit is a fruit similar to an orange, but bigger and not as sweet.

english_definition: Hay is dry grass used to feed animals and can be used for different purposes.
example_sentence: I need to buy some more hay for the horse to eat.

english_definition: If you are horrified, you are very shocked and feel upset.
example_sentence: I was horrified when I read about the old lady who was attacked.

english_definition: Kerosene is a type of oil used in some lamps and stoves.

english_definition: A loop is a line made into the shape of a circle.

english_definition: The middle is nearest the center and with an equal number of things on each side.

english_definition: A paddle is a piece of wood or plastic that moves a boat across water.

english_definition: When something is sour, it has a sharp and unpleasant taste.

english_definition: A stake is a small, sharp piece of wood or metal that is put into the ground.

english_definition: A steward is a person like a waiter who serves food on planes and ships.

english_definition: String is a thin piece of fabric or rope.

english_definition: A thorn is a sharp part of a plant.

english_definition: To wreck something means to destroy or ruin it.

english_definition: To admonish someone is to tell them you disapprove of their behavior.

english_definition: If something is audible, then it is able to be heard.

english_definition: If things or people are awesome, they are impressive or frightening.

english_definition: To beware means to be careful of something or someone that is dangerous.

english_definition: To brag means to talk of one's abilities or achievements in a proud way.

english_definition: If someone is conscious of something, then they are aware of it.

english_definition: To echo means that a sound repeats itself because it bounced off an object.

english_definition: A hint is information that suggests something will happen or is true.

english_definition: An idiot is a person who is not smart or who has done something silly.

english_definition: If something is immense, it is very large.

english_definition: If something is indirect, then it is not the easiest or straightest way.

english_definition: An option is a choice between two or more things.

english_definition: A pastime is an activity that you do often for fun.

english_definition: An essay is a short piece of writing on a certain subject.

english_definition: A gymnasium is a building with equipment that you can use to get exercise.

english_definition: To buzz means to show excitement about something.

english_definition: When animals graze, they feed on plants.

english_definition: If someone is intelligent, they are very smart.

english_definition: An architect is a person who designs buildings.

english_definition: To conceal something means to hide it.

english_definition: If someone commits a crime, he or she does something bad that can be punished by law.

english_definition: A deed is a certificate that proves that someone owns something.

english_definition: Gratitude is a feeling of being thankful.

english_definition: A habitat is the natural home of animals or plants.

english_definition: To intervene means to help stop a problem between two people or groups.

english_definition: A landmark is an object that helps people find or remember a location.

english_definition: If something is memorable, then it is remembered for a special reason.

english_definition: An offense is an action that breaks the law and requires punishment.

english_definition: To proclaim something means to say it in public.

english_definition: A rally is a large public meeting in order to support something.

english_definition: To resolve something means to find a solution.

english_definition: Conduct is the way that someone acts.

english_definition: When an event or action is constant, it happens a lot or all of the time.
example_sentence: The television at home is in constant use.

english_definition: A crack is a narrow space between the parts of something broken.

english_definition: A device is an object or a machine.

english_definition: To enclose something is to contain it.

english_definition: If something is impending, it is going to happen soon.

english_definition: A law is a rule made by the legislative body.

english_definition: A mode is a setting or condition on a machine.

english_definition: To perspire means to sweat.

english_definition: A wage is the money that a person gets for doing a job.

english_definition: When something is animate, it has life.

english_definition: A review of something is a formal inspection of it by people in authority.

english_definition: If someone is sophisticated, they know many things about the world.

english_definition: To surrender something is to give it up.

english_definition: If you are armed, you are carrying a weapon.

english_definition: Bravery is brave behavior.

english_definition: A ceremony is an event that happens on special occasions.

english_definition: Culture is the music, art, and writings of a certain place or group of people.

english_definition: A defense is something that is done to protect another thing.

english_definition: A detail is a small piece of information.

english_definition: When a group of things is diverse, it is made up of a wide variety of things.

english_definition: To enchant someone is to make them feel very interested or happy.

english_definition: A genre is a type of literature, art, or music characterized by its style.

english_definition: An impact is the effect someone or something has.

english_definition: To lure someone is to convince them to do something by using a trick.

english_definition: An obstacle is an object or a problem that stops you from doing something.

english_definition: A shelter is a place to go that is safe from danger or bad weather.

english_definition: To supply something means to give people what they need or want.

english_definition: If people are vain, they are only concerned with how they look.

english_definition: An alternative is something that you can choose instead of your first choice.

english_definition: The belly is the stomach of a person or animal.

english_definition: A current is a steady and constant flow of air or water in a river or ocean.

english_definition: Disrespect is rudeness or behavior that shows a lack of respect.

english_definition: Enthusiasm is a very strong good feeling about something.

english_definition: When something is harsh, it is very unpleasant.

english_definition: Muscle is a mass of tissue attached to bone that helps you move.

english_definition: To rescue someone means to remove them from danger.

english_definition: A succession is a number of things that follow one after the other.
example_sentence: The student said the letters of the alphabet in succession.

english_definition: The terrain is the land and all of its physical features or parts.
example_sentence: The terrain below was rocky and full of hills.

english_definition: If someone is timid, they are afraid, shy, or nervous.

example_sentence: The boy hit his brother in an act of violence.

english_definition: To affect someone or something is to have an influence over them.

english_definition: An autograph is the written name of a famous person.

english_definition: A bead is a drop of liquid.

english_definition: To brew coffee or tea means to pour hot water over it.

english_definition: To charm someone is to please them with your personality.

english_definition: A destiny is all the things that happen or will happen to a person in their life.

english_definition: Equipment consists of the things which are used for a specific purpose.

english_definition: A horn is a device that makes a loud noise.

english_definition: When someone is irritable, they become annoyed or angry very easily.

english_definition: To lag behind is to move slowly behind other moving objects.
example_sentence: The girl on rollerblades lagged behind the little girl on the bicycle.

english_definition: A nightmare is a bad or scary dream.
example_sentence: The girl was scared to go back to sleep because she had had a nightmare.

example_sentence: Mangoes are one of the most nutritious fruits in the world.

english_definition: Protein is a substance that is necessary for the body to grow and be strong.
example_sentence: Fish and beef are good sources of protein.

english_definition: A signature is your name, when you write it in your own way.
example_sentence: I put my signature at the end of the letter.

english_definition: Stuff is a word used to refer to things without mentioning the things by name.

english_definition: When something is subconscious, it is done without thinking about it.
example_sentence: Breathing is one of the subconscious things that the body does.

english_definition: A van is a vehicle that is used for carrying things. It is smaller than a truck.
example_sentence: The delivery company uses large vans to deliver packages.

english_definition: To warn someone is to make them know of possible danger in the future.
example_sentence: The lifeguard warned people to stay away from the rough ocean.

english_definition: A workout is an exercise routine that helps improve health.
example_sentence: She doesn't do her workout on the weekends.

english_definition: To zoom is to move quickly.

english_definition: A brick is a block of hard clay that is used for building things, such as walls.
example_sentence: There were several bricks scattered on the ground.

english_definition: Dough is a mixture of flour and water that becomes bread when baked.

english_definition: To express a feeling or idea means to show others how one thinks or feels.

english_definition: A fist is a hand with fingers bent in toward the palm.

english_definition: If something is flexible, then it can bend easily without breaking.
